US Warns Russia of Moscow Terror Plot; Russia Reports Arrest

The United States issued a warning to Russia about a potential terror plot targeting Moscow, specifically mentioning an alert for a mass casualty event at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve. Following this warning, Russia announced it had arrested one individual in connection with a planned attack on Moscow. Russian authorities stated they were responding to the U.S. report.
